_authority: Owner-edited only. ap3/dispatch.sh reads this file and never writes it. A class is dispatchable only while status == enabled and not paused in ap3/state/trust.json. allowed_scope is the ceiling a queued task's scope must fit inside; widen it only from evidence rows, never to make one task fit.

bugfix-small.description: Small, behaviour-preserving fixes with a test that pins the acceptance criterion. No schema/migration, no auth/permission/money logic.

_w6_policy: Optional per-class W6 policy. preflight (default true): before a run starts, a read-only session checks the task carries enough context; a QUESTIONS verdict holds the task NEEDS_CONTEXT and writes ap3/state/questions/<slug>.md until the owner adds a '## Owner context' section and pushes. auto_resolve governs how a HALT is handled without the owner: outage_retries (infra retry, default 2), extend ('to-cap'|'none', raise a MAX_ROUNDS/BUDGET ceiling once up to budget_usd_max), missing_context ('evidence-only'|'never', let a read-only resolver answer a writer question ONLY when repo/spec facts refute the alternative), scope_widen (default OFF: a SCOPE_DRIFT whose files are all inside allowed_scope widens the pinned scope; opt in per class -- auto-widening from the writer's own drift weakens the per-task boundary under a broad ceiling, so the default is to ESCALATE). Any resolution marks the run agent_resolved and NEVER bumps clean_runs.
